The monthly write-ups singled out Port Moody Centre for detached houses in August (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in July (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, August (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in July, September (a buyers’ best bet).
Port Moody Centre share of Port Moody listings and sales by month

In Port Moody Centre, its share of the houses listed in Port Moody went from 16.5% in June to 11.1% in September and its share of the condos and townhomes listed went from 66.7% to 62.5%. A share that holds steady while the city moves means the community is following the city; a share that drifts means it is moving differently.

blocks.text: Port Moody Centre home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

195 condos sold in Port Moody Centre with a median price of $705,000 (the middle half sold between $602,000 and $797,000), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 97.7% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $809 per square foot, a median year built of 2012 and a median strata fee of $459 a month. 31 townhomes sold in Port Moody Centre with a median price of $1,112,000 (the middle half sold between $954,500 and $1,181,750), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 97.9% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $784 per square foot, a median year built of 2012 and a median strata fee of $430 a month.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Port Moody Centre
Fee-simple lots

items.t: Character: the detached stock is among the city's oldest — the old townsite around St. Johns, Clarke and Murray Streets — on freehold lots, while the attached stock is mostly newer station-area buildings at Inlet Centre, Newport and Suter Brook. A verified age breakdown is UNVERIFIED.
Lot sizes, as the bylaw states them: detached lots are set zone by zone in Zoning Bylaw No. Typical lot dimensions beyond that bylaw minimum: UNVERIFIED — no typical-size table is invented here.

Serviced position: city stock is on municipal water and sewer, with utilities (water, sewer, waste) billed separately from property taxes — the 2026 utility bill was due February 27, 2026. A per-lot servicing figure for a new subdivision: UNVERIFIED.

ALR vs non-ALR: no ALR land was confirmed in this sub-area in the research — the ground is urban station-core and old-townsite fabric, fronting the Burrard Inlet foreshore at Rocky Point and along Murray Street. ALR status remains a per-parcel check on ALC mapping.

blocks.text: Development and assembly ground

items.t: Inlet District by Wesgroup — former Coronation Park lands by Inlet Centre Station (developer source): A 14.8-acre master-planned community of six towers of 26–31 storeys and three 6-storey buildings with 2,486 market condos and 101 market rentals, plus two daycare centres, an office building, a supermarket, a drug store and other retail, and a roughly 2.55-acre park; final rezoning enactment was received in July 2024 and first residents were expected around 2029.

: A live condo presale (Phase 1: a 31-storey tower of 263 condos plus 16 market rental suites), with a future Phase 2 including a 12-storey seniors housing tower. Condo presale product on development ground — counted nowhere as land, and the seniors tower is not stock anywhere until built and offered.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Port Moody Centre

items.t: Port Moody Centre is the city's downtown and station core at the head of the Port Moody Arm of Burrard Inlet, around St. Johns Street, Clarke Street and Murray Street, between Moody Centre Station and Rocky Point Park, taking in the Newport and Suter Brook village areas by Inlet Centre Station; exact board sub-area boundary roads are UNVERIFIED.
Nearby areas: North Shore Pt Moody across the inlet, College Park PM and Glenayre to the west, Heritage Woods PM on the north shore hills, Coquitlam to the east.

Transit: Moody Centre Station combines Millennium Line SkyTrain (Evergreen Extension), West Coast Express commuter rail and a bus loop; Inlet Centre Station is the next SkyTrain station east. Barnet Highway runs west toward Burnaby and Vancouver. Driving commute times: UNVERIFIED — no official source publishes them.

Parks, recreation and health: Rocky Point Park at the head of the inlet has a pier, boat launch, outdoor pool, skate park and playground, and is the start of the Shoreline Trail; the Port Moody Recreation Complex is at 300 Ioco Road, Kyle Centre at 125 Kyle Street, and Port Moody Public Library at 100 Newport Drive. Eagle Ridge Hospital is in Port Moody at 475 Guildford Way (Fraser Health), just east of the centre.

Heritage and history: Port Moody was chosen as the western terminus of the transcontinental railway, and the former CPR station on Murray Street is now the Port Moody Station Museum; Moody Centre is a heritage conservation area (with the Ioco townsite), so a heritage alteration permit can be required for new construction or reconstruction on included properties — a lot-level diligence item in the old townsite.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Port Moody Centre

items.t: City plan: the current Official Community Plan is Port Moody OCP Bylaw 2026, No. 3522 (adopted April 28, 2026; repeals Bylaw No.

SSMUH / small-lot potential, as the City states it: the transit-oriented areas are exempt from small-scale multi-unit housing rules — an RS lot inside a TOA does not gain SSMUH units, while RS lots outside them can add units. In Moody Centre, RS1 lots in OCP Single Family–Low Density areas can be rezoned to RS1-S for small lots of at least 9 m width and 325 m² area — a rezoning route, not an as-of-right split.

Subdivision and servicing — Port Moody servicing bylaw number UNCONFIRMED (held, never borrowed): Neighbouring cities' numbers govern their own municipalities only and are never Port Moody numbers. (Standing verified ledger, applied by exclusion.)

Heritage: Moody Centre is a heritage conservation area (with the Ioco townsite), so a heritage alteration permit can be required for new construction or reconstruction on included properties — check an old-townsite lot's heritage status before pricing a teardown or rebuild.

SkyTrain — stated at its actual status: the two existing stations (Moody Centre and Inlet Centre, Evergreen Extension) are built and operating, per the research. A land price premised on a future station beyond the two existing ones is premised on an UNCONFIRMED item.

ALR rules (for completeness — no Port Moody Centre ALR parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha).

Port Moody property taxes and utilities: property taxes for 2026 were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on outstanding amounts after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% after September 15, 2026; utilities (water, sewer, waste) are billed separately, with the 2026 utility bill due February 27, 2026.

blocks.text: Good to know about Port Moody Centre

items.t: "Port Moody Centre" does not exist in the City's own plan. It is the board sub-area name; the OCP (Bylaw 2026, No.

Port Moody replaced its OCP in 2026, and the old number is everywhere. OCP Bylaw 2026, No. 3522 was adopted April 28, 2026 and repeals Bylaw No. 2955; listing packages and older guides still cite 2955. Any OCP argument for a centre land purchase should run off 3522.

The station-area exemption cuts the opposite way from most BC cities. Here, being closest to SkyTrain removes SSMUH rights rather than adding them — the transit-oriented areas are exempt — so an older house lot a few streets outside the TOA can carry more as-of-right unit potential than one beside the station.
A verified building can still have an unverifiable year.

The hospital tower money is next door, not in the sub-area's land story. Eagle Ridge Hospital (475 Guildford Way) sits just east of the centre — the amenity is real, but it does not change the centre's land position: no bare-land market, house lots and development ground only.

Utilities are a separate February bill. Port Moody bills water, sewer and waste separately from property taxes, with the utility bill due in February — a carrying-cost line a land buyer used to combined bills will miss.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 15 houses and 120 condos and townhomes listed in Port Moody Centre. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Port Moody Centre a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 13% (a balanced market); condos and townhomes had 13% (a balanced market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Port Moody Centre from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 9 houses and 92 condos and townhomes sold in Port Moody Centre over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in August with 6 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in August with 31 sold.

faq.q: How big is Port Moody Centre compared with the rest of Port Moody?
faq.a: In September 2026, Port Moody Centre held 11.1% of the 135 detached houses listed in Port Moody and 62.5% of the 192 condos and townhomes listed in Port Moody.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 11.1% of the 135 homes listed in Port Moody Centre and condos and townhomes made up 88.9%; of the 18 that sold, houses were 11.1% and condos and townhomes 88.9%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Port Moody Centre than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 21 in June to 15 in September 2026 (−28.6%); condos and townhomes fell from 144 in June to 120 in September 2026 (−16.7%).

faq.q: Is Port Moody Centre an official neighbourhood name?
faq.a: No — it is the board (MLS) sub-area name. The City's Official Community Plan covers the same ground as Moody Centre (Section 14.6) and Inlet Centre (Section 14.5).

faq.q: Which stations serve Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: Moody Centre Station has Millennium Line SkyTrain, West Coast Express and a bus loop, and Inlet Centre Station is the next SkyTrain station east.

faq.q: Are there heritage rules for older homes here?
faq.a: Yes — Moody Centre is a heritage conservation area, so included properties can need a heritage alteration permit for construction or reconstruction.

faq.q: What did condos in Port Moody Centre sell for?
faq.a: 195 condos sold in Port Moody Centre between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $705,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: The median was 26 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.7% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I buy a vacant lot in Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: No vacant-lot offering is verified — no named bare-land subdivision, no bare-land strata offered as lots, and presale lot offerings verified: zero.

faq.q: What is the big development near Inlet Centre Station — can I buy land in it?
faq.a: No — Wesgroup's Inlet District is a rezoned condo masterplan on the former Coronation Park lands (six towers and three low-rise buildings, ~2,500 homes, first residents expected around 2029, developer source). You buy a condo there under REDMA presale rules, not a lot.

faq.q: Can I split a Moody Centre house lot into small lots?
faq.a: Possibly, by rezoning only: RS1 lots in OCP Single Family–Low Density areas can be rezoned to RS1-S for small lots of at least 9 m width and 325 m².

faq.q: Can I add multiplex units to a lot near a station?
faq.a: Not under SSMUH — the transit-oriented areas are exempt from small-scale multi-unit housing rules. RS lots outside the TOAs are the ones that can add units. Confirm which side of the TOA boundary the lot sits on before pricing any density.

faq.q: Do heritage rules affect a teardown lot here?
faq.a: They can — Moody Centre is a heritage conservation area, and included properties can need a heritage alteration permit for construction or reconstruction. Check the specific lot before pricing a rebuild.
